name: Victoria in Big City
source: "Victoria in Big City". You play as Victoria, a young woman who makes the difficult decision to uproot her stable life in her hometown to move to Big City, a bustling metropolis, to pursue better career opportunities. This new environment brings its own challenges and adventures, and it's up to you to make the decisions that will shape Victoria's new path in life.​
translation: 在《维多利亚在大城市》中，你将扮演年轻女子维多利亚。为了争取更好的工作机会，她艰难地下定决心，告别家乡安稳的生活，搬去“大城市”这座繁华的大都会。新环境带来了新的挑战与冒险，而塑造维多利亚人生新道路的每一个决定，都将由你做出。
